records.deidentified_narrative: on the above date and time, police responded to the location for a female pedestrian whom was hit by a passing vehicle. contact was made with the pedestrian who advised that the accident had occured around 1430 hours but since she had a job interview she went to the interview and returned to the scene and then called police. the pedestrian had visible scratched and small open wounds on her chin, right wrist and right elbow and forearm area. the pedestrian also had black sud from the roadway all over her right side leg, hip, abdomen and shoulder area. bhfd was called to the location to medically evaluate the pedestrian. while the fire/medic personnel were evaluating the pedestrian, she stated that her head was hurting (a 10 on a scale of 1 thru 10), her right shoulder and her hip were both hurting. bhfd fire/medic personnel determined that the pedestrian required further medical evaluation and acadian ambulance service was contacted. shortly after, acadian ambulance #75 arrived at location and began evaluating the pedestrian. as per the pedestrian, she was walking southbound on [roadway] on the sidewalk when she came to a connector section between the [roadway] and the [roadway]. as per the pedestrian, she attempted to cross the connector and was hit by a late model black pickup truck. the pedestrian stated she went airborne and landed approximately 10 feet in front of the pickup truck. as per the pedestrian, the pickup truck driver did approach her and asked her if she required medical attention but the pedestrian denied his request citing she had a job interview to go to. the pedestrian was then driven to her job interview by a couple in another vehicle that had stopped to check on her when she was hit. as per the pedestrian, she was later dropped off at the black friday where her cousin was waiting for her and who advised her to call police. no information was obtained for the black pick up truck or it's driver and occupants but no criminal charges will be filed as they did stop to render aid but their aid was denied. [medical facility] for further medical evaluation but did state she felt ""fine, just sore"" (in her native tounge) and did not want to pursue charges. no further information was obtained at this time. end of report.

records.deidentified_narrative: unit #2 was walking south on fm 1314 on the southbound side while unit #1 was also traveling south on fm 1314. kelly, the driver of unit #1, stated she had just left a wedding which was located in the city of montgomery and was heading home. while traveling on fm 1314, kelly stated that she all of a sudden struck a pedestrian, later identified as darrell brumek, with the front right area of her vehicle due to him walking on the fog line. this impact caused darrell to be thrown approximately 112 feet and landing on the southbound lanes of fm 1314. after this event, darrell was then run over by a charter bus. see crash report 24a064880 for further information. kelly did state she had consumed two (2) 12 ounce beers and some champagne while at the wedding. i could smell the odor of alcohol emitting from kelly's person while speaking with her. kelly was observed to be chewing gum and i asked her how long she had been chewing that piece of gum with her response being after the crash occurred. kelly asked and refused to breathe into a pbt, portable breath test, device and made statements such as ""my life is ruined"". kelly was administered standardized field sobriety test's by deputy wright which concluded she passed. mcso detectives are currently investigating this incident. see death investigation report 23a341613 for additional information.
